notes: חֲזַק → *Be of good courage* and נִתְחַזְּקָה → *let us play the man*, each headed on the complement (rule 44).
הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָיו → *that which seemeth him good*: article takes *that which* (rule 41), בְּעֵינֵי fuses on *seemeth*, suffix keeps *him*; the copula-on-adjective reading is named as competing.
